seed_fields.description: Return x,y,z,phase,hit for each requested cylinder intersection. All inputs are aligned finite float64 vectors, including empty vectors. Lengths share caller-defined units; pitch is axial advance per revolution. Direction uses its sign only. Radius and target radius squared must be positive; pitch, direction and transverse center magnitude must be nonzero. Initial points are assumed to lie on the specified helix; this relationship is caller responsibility. Minimum phase is a signed dimensionless movement bound, allowing backward reselection. Four source candidate phases are considered, not an unbounded multi-revolution search. Geometric misses return NaN coordinates/phase and false hit flags. Undefined or nonfinite intermediate arithmetic raises.
